command:
set -euo pipefail
sudo kubectl get --raw=/readyz
sudo kubectl get management -o wide
sudo kubectl -n kcm-system get backupstoragelocations -o wide
sudo kubectl get pods -A -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;x=json.load(sys.stdin)["items"];bad=[(p["metadata"]["namespace"],p["metadata"]["name"],p["status"]["phase"]) for p in x if p["status"]["phase"]!="Succeeded" and not all(c.get("ready",False) for c in p["status"].get("containerStatuses",[{}]))];print("not_ready",bad);assert not bad'
